null_definition: For each butterfly, preserve exact resolved host-species count and exact WCVP host-family composition; sample alternative HOSTS-WCVP host species without replacement within each family and reconstruct native and contemporary WGSRPD3 resource unions.
interpretation: Known butterfly host identities produce substantially more anthropogenic geographic resource expansion than random host sets with the same resolved host-species count and plant-family composition. This excess is not preferentially associated with broader family-level diets.
architecture_note: Architecture comparisons remain secondary because concentration metrics are structurally bounded by portfolio size and exact-host-count diagnostics remove the marginal specialist-generalist gradient.
claim_boundary: Post-hoc robustness analysis motivated by manuscript review. The null controls exact host count and plant-family composition but does not randomize evolutionary host accessibility, interaction-record completeness, local host use or causal butterfly range expansion.
